question: does the surviving d_surface headline survive multiplicity, and under which family?

A_tested_layers_only_m4.why_wrong: the four layers were SELECTED as the top four of eleven, so m=4 ignores the selection

B_profile_family_m11.why: the natural family for a per-layer claim: the 11 layer arms actually run

C_layers_plus_this_sessions_cross_arm_te.why: the same author ran all of these on the same data in one session -- the classic garden-of-forking-paths family

VERDICT: L12 sits exactly on the boundary. It SURVIVES Holm over the layer family (0.043) and FAILS if the session's cross-arm tests are pooled into the family (0.055). Which family is right is a judgment call, not a fact: the cross-arm tests answer different questions, but they were run by the same author on the same data in the same session. Under NO defensible family does anything else in the d_surface story survive -- L8, L10 and L6 fail everywhere except the m=4 family, which is indefensible because the layers were outcome-selected.
robust_regardless: arm D and arm C survive every family definition tried (Holm-adjusted <= 0.002).
